summary: ACM Research filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 furnishing a press release in which its Shanghai-listed operating subsidiary, ACM Research (Shanghai), disclosed backlog data posted to the Shanghai Stock Exchange. Total backlog as of September 29, 2026 was RMB 17.1 billion (about USD 2.5 billion), an 88.2% year-over-year increase, comprising shipped-but-unrecognized tools and future shipments under Chinese GAAP. No securities transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are involved; the filing also notes upcoming October 28, 2026 results and an early-November call.
